sourceRoot.description: Content source root token. One of: engineTemplates | engineFeaturePacks | engineContent | enginePlugins | megascansLibrary | fabLibrary | projectContent | projectPlugins. A filesystem path is never accepted here — the token is resolved plugin-side, so no directory outside these roots is reachable. megascansLibrary probes both the shell Documents folder and the profile Documents folder (OneDrive redirects the first) and honours MCP_MEGASCANS_LIBRARY_DIR; fabLibrary reads the Fab plugin's own UFabSettings.CacheDirectoryPath and honours MCP_FAB_LIBRARY_DIR. The Fab plugin owns its own sign-in and downloading — these roots only read what it already placed on disk.

overwrite.description: Overwrite packages that already exist at the destination. Default false, which skips them and reports skippedCount.

dryRun.description: Report what would be copied without writing anything. Returns the same counts and packagePaths sample.

discovery.summary: Add a node to a material graph: any expression class by name, or a typed node (parameters, texture sample/coordinate, math, noise, panner, rotator, fresnel, switches, custom HLSL, function call, landscape layer), or build a whole graph (nodes, wires, material properties) in one batch.

operations.description: Steps run in order, 1-200. Each is {edit, ...the params of that edit}: edit is a node adder (add_material_node, add_scalar_parameter, add_vector_parameter, add_texture_sample, add_texture_coordinate, add_math_node, add_noise, add_custom_expression, ...), use_material_function, connect_nodes, set_node_position, update_custom_expression, set_blend_mode, set_shading_model, set_material_domain or set_two_sided. Optional per step: id (names the created node; later steps use "$id" in sourceNodeId/targetNodeId/nodeId), from/to ("$id.Pin" shorthand for connect_nodes, where a source pin may be channel letters like "$uv.G"; "Main.EmissiveColor" is the material output). A created node without x/y is laid out automatically. Deleting and disconnecting are not batched. The batch stops at the first failing step; when every step ran, the material is compiled and saved once.

discovery.summary: Read the most recent editor log lines (kept since editor start), filtered by text, category or minimum severity.
whenToUse: A one-shot historical log read is needed: Live Coding or compile results, PIE warnings such as Accessed None, or the output of a console command that only logs (au.DumpActiveSounds).
whenNotToUse: New lines must be streamed as they arrive (use subscribe).

action.description: The action to execute on the parent tool.

lines.description: How many of the newest matching lines to return, oldest first (default 100, max 1000).

filter.description: Case-insensitive plain text (not a regex) a line must contain; separate alternatives with | to match any of them (LoadMap|Bringing World).

category.description: Only lines of this log category, e.g. LogBlueprintUserMessages.

minVerbosity.description: Least severe level to include (default log): error returns errors only, warning adds warnings, verbose returns everything.

source.description: editor (default): the editor log. build: the UnrealBuildTool log of the last compile, where the compiler errors behind "Live coding failed" go. livecoding: the Live Coding console log (patching and linking). previous: the log of the editor's previous run, e.g. why an editor that went away exited. Only filter and lines apply to build, livecoding and previous.

runsBack.description: With source previous: how many editor runs back to read (default 1, max 20). After a crash and one more restart, the crashed run is 2.

details.description: Additional handler result fields not named by the contract.

lines.description: Matching lines as "[seconds since start] Category: Verbosity: message", oldest first.

matched.description: How many buffered lines matched; more than returned means the lines cap cut the oldest.

logFile.description: For build, livecoding and previous: the file read. A previous run's name carries its start time.
